purpose: Low-entropy image-to-video consistency test for WorldSculpt preprocessing

anchor.prompt: Photorealistic calm minimalist meditation room, a simple rectangular room with smooth warm off-white plaster walls and a continuous pale oak floor. Exactly one low oak bench centered against the back wall, exactly one large plain oatmeal rug centered on the floor, exactly one tall potted olive tree in the back-right corner, and exactly one round white paper pendant lamp overhead. Empty clean room, no windows, no doors visible, no shelves, no small objects. Soft diffuse daylight, even exposure, eye-level wide shot, 24mm lens, deep focus, physically plausible materials, quiet and relaxed atmosphere, fixed architectural geometry, high spatial coherence. No people, no animals, no text, no clutter, no extra furniture.

video.prompt: A rigid, completely static empty meditation room. The camera makes a very slow, smooth clockwise orbit of about 35 degrees around the center of the rug, at constant eye-level height, constant 24mm focal length and constant exposure. The walls, floor, low bench, rug, planter, olive tree and pendant lamp remain exactly fixed, unchanged and stationary. Photorealistic, deep focus, stable geometry, gentle diffuse lighting.
video.negative_prompt: people, animals, wind, moving leaves, moving objects, object duplication, extra furniture, appearing objects, disappearing objects, morphing geometry, bending walls, changing room layout, doors, windows, cuts, transitions, camera jump, zoom, dolly, focal length change, exposure change, flicker, motion blur, shallow depth of field, text, logo, watermark

visual_qa.observed_drift: The woven basket in the anchor becomes a simpler planter at video initialization; it remains stable throughout the video.
visual_qa.camera_motion: Smooth and cut-free, but substantially smaller than the requested 35-degree orbit.
visual_qa.notes: All 12 extracted frames are full-resolution 1280x720. Camera poses are not calibrated and must be recovered before metric reconstruction.
